Body.Content: Serverless compute for notebooks allows you to run your notebooks quickly without configuring and deploying infrastructure. With serverless compute, Azure Databricks efficiently manages the compute resources that run your notebook, including optimizing and scaling compute for your notebook. See Run your Azure Databricks notebook with serverless compute.
